notes.title: Cheat Code and Lewd Animations!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468420/Sexcraft__Sofiya_and_the_Lewd_Clan/]Sexcraft[/url] has a cheat code, so if you think the game is too hard or you just want to make it easier, you can use it. Pay attention to the information below.

[b]Chet Code Hotkey: F10[/b]

- The lewd animations will be unlocked on specific levels - usually when you face a monster with a lewd ani~ for the first time. If you start the level but don't complete it, you’ll not unlock the animation in your gallery. In other others, what unlocks a lewd animation in the gallery is a trigger at the end of the level - not having sex with a monster.

- If you use the Cheat Code to skip the levels by pressing “Next Level” or to move around the room by pressing “Free Move”, you’ll probably not unlock the lewd animations. If you use “Free Move”, it will be better if you reach almost the end of the level, disable the Cheat Code, and reach the end by yourself because you need to touch on an invisible collider to unlock the animations.

Thank you all for supporting Hentai Room and don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/h-room]Steam page[/url]. New games will be announced soon.

Hentai Room Team

ps: use the cheat code at your own risk!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Some bugs have been fixed.

[list]
[*] Lewd Gallery Bug has been fixed: Now, after you unlock the lewd animations, they will be unlocked in the gallery. If you have already started the game, please, start a new one.
[*] Lewd Book 03 has been fixed: Now, you'll see the image instead of a white image.
[*] Black Screen has been fixed: Now, save files from the demo version will be automatically deleted and we hope to fix the black screen problem. Post on the forum (Bug Section) if this bug persists.
[/list]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743290/Sexcraft__Walkthrough/]Walkthrough Document[/url] is also available. You can buy it 10% OFF during the game launch week.

Thank you all for your patience and don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/h-room]Steam page[/url].

New games will be announced soon.

Hentai Room Team
